comparison.objective: Feed springy filament into a narrow 3D-printer inlet; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually straighten, align, and insert a flexible filament versus manipulate a rigid captive lock and collar and evaluate impact response.
comparison.success_condition: Filament inserted at least 20 mm, released, and still versus two safe repeatable damper cycles with a stable locked setting.
comparison.reason: Flexible linear insertion differs from rigid adjustment plus dynamic energy-management testing.
